dbl.text: Kaima is a kami once bonded to Chishiro, who recalls how a boy poisoned his order at their haven and demanded that Kaima bond with him.
Chishiro let Kaima go, the blade shattered and the bond broke, and Kaima trampled the boy and vanished.

Years later, when Tatsunari stabs Chishiro through the gut, the shrine's kami awakens, its roots healing Chishiro and attacking the Mukotai, and Chishiro realizes the awakened kami is Kaima, who intends to destroy everyone.
Chishiro and Kaima realize their rage has poisoned each other and stand down, and when Chishiro offers peace, Kaima asks him to bond again, and Chishiro raises the blade as a light is reborn.
